recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13979 unless Patient Care later changes Communication.topic's value-set content or binding strength.
issue_request: FHIR-13979 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked Patient Care to create an example binding for Communication.topic after FHIR-13705 changed the element from Reference(Any) to CodeableConcept. The approved resolution was to define a FHIR value set with codes such as prescription refill request, progress update, report labs, appointment reminder, phone consult, and summary report.
initial_application: Historical commit edd8a7650ab34c3be2f69f49a42d8e59954e3e2e changed the old source/communication/communication-spreadsheet.xml CommunicationTopic binding row from unbound to an example #communication-topic code-list binding and added the requested code-list sheet. Source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried the applied binding into the current Communication StructureDefinition and communication-topic ValueSet XML files.
additional_context: Communication is active in source/fhir.ini and its value sets are marked approved. Current source defines Communication.topic as CodeableConcept with an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/communication-topic. That value set composes all codes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/communication-topic, and the local terminology package contains the six requested example concepts. Later QA/source cleanup changed value-set metadata but did not remove the binding or code expansion. Bounded Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already expresses the requested example binding and its terminology target supplies the requested code list.

related_jiras.note: Changed Communication.topic to CodeableConcept, which created the need for this binding.
Later added the Communication.topic search parameter and is already represented by a no-change audit commit on the combined branch.
